verdict.rationale: ClickUp's vendor docs describe a built-in AI assistant ('Brain²') and pre-built agents (Codegen Agent, Triage Agent, 'Super Agent' for task delegation), directly matching the story. However, all evidence is vendor-sourced marketing copy with no independent/community confirmation of these AI delegation features actually working well, and general community sentiment about ClickUp's engineering quality is quite negative, casting some doubt on execution.
